shared_task.design_request: 研究者迁移任务：四人家庭的共同起居和用餐房间需保留已有八件家具的身份与尺寸，支持四个餐位、沙发起居和收纳取放，保持入口与窗前通行。家具位置可调整，具体活动需要由单独的条件卡给出。房间、已有家具和尺寸均为研究假设；本任务不指定采用哪种分隔或摆法。
unknowns: Only a shared living/dining room is represented, not the original three-storey57m²home; cooking, sleeping and bathroom spaces are outside this room.
All dimensions, existing items, openings, observer points and task variants are researcher assumptions.
Tall storage is a solid opaque proxy; actual doors, shelves, capacity and source furniture are unknown.
Sight rays are geometric indicators, not perceived openness, privacy, acoustic isolation or professional preference.
Square-body approach checks do not establish real seating, reach, comfort or moving feasibility.

variants.request: 家人在餐桌处理日常事务时，希望仍能看见沙发上的家人，便于共同交流；保留所有家具以及用餐、起居、收纳和通行。
variants.provenance: Researcher operationalisation of the sourced shared-living preference, not a resident quotation.
variants.indicator: More unobstructed declared dining-to-sofa sight rays is preferred, conditional on retained access.

variants.request: 一人在餐桌处理事务，另一人在沙发活动时，希望两处之间减少直接视线干扰；保留所有家具以及用餐、起居、收纳和通行。不要求隔音。
variants.provenance: Researcher-constructed contrast; not an F-House resident requirement or historical rejected alternative.
variants.indicator: Fewer unobstructed declared dining-to-sofa sight rays is preferred, conditional on retained access.
